What is Wamda?

Wamda moves files straight from one phone to another over Wi-Fi Direct. It needs no internet connection and no account, and it shows no ads. Every connection between the two devices is encrypted with TLS 1.3, and the transfer protocol is open and documented so anyone can review it.
What we never collect
• Your files, copies of them, or their metadata.\n• Your location, contacts, or any advertising identifiers.\n• Analytics or usage logs; there are no accounts and no servers your data passes through.
How it works

• The receiver shows a QR code (or announces itself over Bluetooth LE) carrying the temporary network name, its password and the certificate fingerprint.\n• The sender scans the code and joins a temporary Wi-Fi Direct network shared by the two phones only.\n• Files travel over a direct TLS 1.3 connection, and the temporary network is removed when the transfer ends.

This policy explains what data the Wamda app (the "App") processes and what it does not collect. In short: your files move directly between two devices over a local network, the App has no servers, no accounts and no analytics, and nothing leaves your phone except to the device you chose yourself.
1. Data we process

• Files you choose to send: read from your device and sent over a direct, encrypted Wi-Fi Direct connection to the receiving device only. They never pass through the internet or any server.
• Device name: the name you set in Settings (or the default device name) is shown to the other party during discovery and connection.
• Temporary connection details: the Wi-Fi Direct network name, its password and the TLS certificate fingerprint. They are generated at random for each session, shared through a QR code or Bluetooth LE, and discarded when the transfer ends.
• Transfer history: the App stores locally on your device the other device name, the number of files, their sizes, the transfer speed and the time of the transfer.
• Settings: your preferences such as the device name, theme and the list of trusted devices.
2. Data we do not collect

The App does not collect, and does not send to anyone, the contents or names of your files, your geographic location, your contacts, device or advertising identifiers, usage logs or analytics, or any personally identifying information. There are no user accounts, no servers operated by us, no ads, and no third-party libraries that collect data.
3. Permissions and why we ask for them

• Nearby devices (Android 13 and later) or Location (Android 12 and earlier): Android requires this permission to use Wi-Fi Direct and Bluetooth LE. The App never uses it to determine your location and never reads location data.
• Bluetooth: to discover nearby devices running the App and read their connection details.
• Camera: to scan QR codes only. No images are saved, recorded or sent.
• Photos, videos and audio: to list your files inside the App so you can choose what to send. No file is read unless you pick it for sending.
• Notifications: to show transfer progress while the App works in the background.
4. Storage and retention

Received files are saved to the Download/Wamda folder on your device and remain under your control. Transfer history and settings are stored locally only. You can clear the history at any time from the History screen inside the App, or remove all data by uninstalling the App. The App keeps no data outside your device.
5. Security

Every connection between the two devices is encrypted with TLS 1.3. Each device generates its own certificate, and the certificate fingerprint is pinned through the QR code or Bluetooth LE before the transfer starts, so no other device on the network can impersonate the receiver or read the data. The temporary Wi-Fi Direct network is created with a random password and removed when the transfer ends.
6. Children

The App does not collect personal data from any user, including children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child shared files through the App with another device, those files exist only on that device and can be deleted from it directly.
7. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when new features are added. The updated version will be published inside the App together with its last-updated date, and any material change will be shown clearly on the first launch after the update.
